gpa.notes: No minimum average published on https://you.ubc.ca/programs/computer-science-vancouver-bsc/ (lists required courses only: e.g. IB Diploma with at least three Higher Level courses, Math Analysis and Approaches / Applications and Interpretations HL, one of IB Biology/Chemistry/Physics). University-wide requirements pages give course requirements, not a numeric minimum.

tuition.notes: Value comes from the page's inline cost-estimator data (script 'pb-cost-estimator-js-extra', var costEstimatorData -> vancouver -> programs -> computer_science), which the page renders as its 'first year cost' estimate. It is NOT in the readable text, so the container quote check is expected to report quote_found=false. Academic year not stated in the data; student fees 1358, books/supplies separately. The you.ubc.ca tuition-fees and cost pages carry no CS figure in text.
